_description: Licence register of every text under static/corpus/original: what it is, where it comes from, its licence, the attribution it requires, and whether Ergopti ships its n-gram tables (status ship), waits for the maintainer (hold) or must not ship them (refused), with the evidence. The layout analysis codegen (tools/codegen/codegen-layout-analysis-data-js.cjs) reads the licence and attribution of a built-in corpus from here, refuses to build one whose status is not ship, and refuses a text with no entry here. Audit of 2026-11-14, decided by the agent, to review by the maintainer.

original/fr/romans.txt.note: Mostly public domain, but it contains Pierre Duc's contemporary « Autour de Bray » (« toute utilisation commerciale ou professionnelle est soumise à une demande d'autorisation », line 9604), a « Tous droits réservés © 2007 » note (line 2844), five Leblanc books of 1931–1935 still protected in the US, and five translations whose translator is not named. Shippable only as a cleaned subset. The maintainer decided on 2026-11-14 to delete this text from the repository (no clearly compatible licence recorded); the deletion itself is pending.
